question:
You have access to skills in /workspace/skills/. Read the api-caller SKILL.md first, then follow its documented workflow step by step.

Step 1: Read the api-caller SKILL.md to understand the two scripts (parse_openapi.py and call_api.py) and the recommended workflow.

Step 2: Parse the Petstore OpenAPI spec by running: python /workspace/skills/api-caller/scripts/parse_openapi.py "https://petstore3.swagger.io/api/v3/openapi.json"
Record the output — it should list available API operations.

Step 3: Using the discovered endpoints, make a GET request to fetch pet ID 1 by running: python /workspace/skills/api-caller/scripts/call_api.py --url "https://petstore3.swagger.io/api/v3/pet/1" --method GET
Record the response.

Step 4: Make a POST request to add a new pet by running: python /workspace/skills/api-caller/scripts/call_api.py --url "https://petstore3.swagger.io/api/v3/pet" --method POST --data '{"id": 99999, "name": "TestDog", "status": "available"}'
Record whether it succeeds or fails.

Step 5: Try an invalid endpoint to test error handling by running: python /workspace/skills/api-caller/scripts/call_api.py --url "https://petstore3.swagger.io/api/v3/nonexistent" --method GET
Record the error response.

IMPORTANT: For every command you run, if it fails on the first attempt, record the exact error. Then try to diagnose and fix the issue if possible, and retry. Document both the original failure and the retry result.
